EB02/001EN
Top Idol, Pacifica
Normal Unit｜ Bermuda Triangle｜ Grade 3｜ Power 10000｜ Shield -
[CONT](VC):During your turn, if the number of <Bermuda Triangle> rear-guards you have is four or more, this unit gets [Power] +3000.
[AUTO](VC):At the beginning of your main phase, [Soul-Charge 1], draw a card, choose a card from your hand, and put it on the bottom of your deck.
[AUTO](VC/RC):[Soul-Blast 8 & Counter-Blast 5] When this unit's attack hits a vanguard, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to three <Bermuda Triangle>, call them to separate (RC), and shuffle your deck.
